file::src/data/Boost.ts.name: Boost.ts
file::src/data/Boost.ts.summary: Defines the damage boost calculation system for the Voxel Blade build calculator. Contains BoostDef/BoostContext interfaces and a comprehensive BOOST_DEFS array of 30+ damage boosts (Blood Thirsty, Frenzy, Primal, Penance, Vampire, etc.), each with either simple multiplier-per-perk values or complex custom calcFn closures. Also exports helper functions calcMinionAbsorptionPotency and calcFrenzyPct, and Penance bleed constants.

file::src/data/debuffCombatEffects.ts.name: debuffCombatEffects.ts
file::src/data/debuffCombatEffects.ts.summary: Defines the combat effects applied by debuffs on enemies. Exports a DEBUFF_COMBAT_EFFECTS record mapping debuff names (Weakness, Shatter, Sticky variants, Electrical Rend, Despair, Frostbite, Hypnotized) to DebuffCombatEffect objects containing description generators, damage multipliers, defense reductions, and element-specific damage multipliers.

file::src/data/enemyHpEffects.ts.name: enemyHpEffects.ts
file::src/data/enemyHpEffects.ts.summary: Defines HP-gated enemy effects that trigger based on enemy current HP percentage. Contains interfaces for HP gates, debuff effects, and DoT boosts, plus a static ENEMY_HP_EFFECT_DEFS array (currently Mycotic Bloom). Exports functions getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs and getEnemyHpDotMultiplier to evaluate which effects are active given the current enemy HP and active debuffs.

file::src/data/perkAutoDebuffs.ts.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
file::src/data/perkAutoDebuffs.ts.summary: Determines which debuffs are automatically applied by perks during combat. Contains calcActualHpFillPct for effective HP calculation accounting for protection, and getAutoDebuffs which evaluates 16+ perk conditions (Exhaust, Penance, Melting Shred, Fungal Prototype, Venom Spitter, Toxin Caster, Gorecast, Splinter, Bellowing Ember, Frostbite, Gelid Lance, Weakening, Sunburn, Fiery Pursuit, Pyre Bloom, Hypnotist) to produce GrantedBuff arrays.

file::src/lib/constants/debuff-effects.t.name: debuff-effects.ts

file::src/lib/constants/game.ts.name: game.ts

file::src/lib/constants/perks.ts.name: perks.ts

file::src/lib/constants/buffs.ts.name: buffs.ts
file::src/lib/constants/buffs.ts.summary: Pure constants module defining buff/debuff potency and duration values for the Voxel Blade damage engine. No functions or classes — serves as a centralized data registry consumed by the buff calculation engine.

file::src/data/BuffData.ts.name: BuffData.ts
file::src/data/BuffData.ts.summary: Core buff and debuff data module for the Voxel Blade damage calculator. Defines all buff/debuff definitions (BUFF_DEFS), item-sourced buffs (ITEM_BUFF_MAP), perk-sourced buff factories (PERK_BUFFS), weapon art buffs, and race buffs. Provides functions to assemble active buffs from a build, apply perk-based potency/duration modifiers (Bastion Bless, Trickster, Generic Debuff, Contained, Dark One), convert Tailwind to Whirlwind, compute True Balance conversions, generate dynamic buff descriptions, and calculate buff effects. Exports 15 symbols and contains 21 functions.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:formatDama.name: formatDamageTypes
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:formatDama.summary: Helper to format an array of damage type strings into a human-readable comma-separated list with 'and' before the last item.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getWeaponA.name: getWeaponArtBuffs
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getWeaponA.summary: Looks up and returns the GrantedBuff array for a given weapon art name from the internal WEAPON_ART_BUFF_MAP.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getTrueBal.name: getTrueBalanceBuffs
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getTrueBal.summary: Computes True Balance buff conversions: maps active enemy debuffs (Bleed, Burn, Poison -> Regen; Frostbite, Slowness, Sticky -> Tailwind; Shatter, Electrical Rend, Hypnotized -> Reinforce; Weakness -> Rage; Despair -> Inspired) based on perk amount, grouping by target buff and taking max potency/duration.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:durationMu.name: durationMultFromStack
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:durationMu.summary: Factory that returns a function computing duration multiplier from stack count: base + perStack * stacks.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getSpecifi.name: getSpecificBuffModifiers
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getSpecifi.summary: Computes per-buff potency bonus and duration multiplier from specific modifiers (Gladiatorial Rage, Mage Rage, Oceans Rage, Slayer Rage, Fury, Iron Slayer, Tailwind, Wind Walker, Slow Leak, Potion Chugger, Bounce Momentum). Filters by rune source and self-debuff eligibility.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getBastion.name: getBastionBlessBonus
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getBastion.summary: Computes Bastion Bless potency bonus for non-debuff, non-neutral, non-self-debuff, non-capped buffs as BASTION_BLESS_MULT * stacks * potency.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getGeneric.name: getGenericDebuffModifiers
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getGeneric.summary: Computes generic debuff modifiers (Endless Despair, Stored Corruption) for enemy debuffs: potency multiplier, flat bonus, and duration multiplier. Excludes self-debuffs except Despair.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getTrickst.name: getTricksterReflection
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getTrickst.summary: Calculates Trickster reflection bonus for self-applied Despair debuffs: (tricksterStacks / 10) * (1 + warding-adjusted potency), compensating for post-hoc Warding multiplication.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:applyBuffP.name: applyBuffPerkModifiers
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:applyBuffP.summary: Main buff modification pipeline. For each buff, computes and merges specific modifiers, Bastion Bless bonus, Trickster reflection, generic debuff modifiers, Contained multiplier, and Dark One duration multiplier. Returns new buff arrays with adjusted potency and duration.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:applyToxin.name: applyToxinTransferDuration
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:applyToxin.summary: Adjusts Toxin Transfer poison buff duration to match the maximum self-poison duration plus TOXIN_TRANSFER_DURATION_EXTRA.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:convertTai.name: convertTailwindToWhirlwind
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:convertTai.summary: Converts all Tailwind buffs to Whirlwind with scaled duration when Whirlwind perk is active. Also adds a 5s Bleed from the wind slash AoE.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getBuffDes.name: getBuffDescription
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getBuffDes.summary: Generates a human-readable description for a buff by name, using dynamicDescription if available or static description. Special-cases Weakness (dmg reduction), Shatter (armor loss), and Anti Heal (healing reduction). Replaces 'x%' placeholders with computed values.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getPerkBuf.name: getPerkBuffs
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getPerkBuf.summary: Iterates over all perks with amount > 0, calls their PERK_BUFFS factory functions, and collects the resulting GrantedBuff arrays.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getActiveB.name: getActiveBuildBuffs
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getActiveB.summary: Collects all buffs from a build's equipment slots (rune, ring, infusion ring, helmet, chestplate, leggings, weapon blade, weapon handle, monk glove) by looking up each item in BUFFS_BY_ITEM_SOURCE, plus race buffs.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getRaceBuf.name: getRaceBuffs
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getRaceBuf.summary: Returns race-specific buffs from RACE_BUFF_MAP (BUNIKIN critical boost on dodge, DARK ELF random debuff pool on hit).

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:applyCaute.name: applyCauterizeConversion
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:applyCaute.summary: When Cauterize perk is active and Cursed Flames is not, marks all enemy-applied Burn entries with burnMode 'singed' to trigger burst-on-application instead of DoT.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getBurnApp.name: getBurnApplicationCount
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:getBurnApp.summary: Returns the count of Burn buff entries in the buff list, used to multiply Cauterize/Singed burst damage.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:assembleAc.name: assembleActiveBuffs
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:assembleAc.summary: Main assembly pipeline: collects item buffs + potion buffs + perk buffs + weapon art buffs, applies applyBuffPerkModifiers, convertTailwindToWhirlwind, and applyCauterizeConversion. Shared helper for the damage calculation engine.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:calcBuffEf.name: calcBuffEffect
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:calcBuffEf.summary: Computes the effect value for a buff at a given potency: effectPerTenthPotency * potency * 10. Returns value, unit ('%' or 'flat'), and a formatted label string.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:calcPotenc.name: calcPotencyPercent
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:calcPotenc.summary: Computes a scaled potency percentage from perk amount using the formula: floor(p^min(1,p)+1 * 100 * (1 + p/1.5) * 100) / 100, used for perk description formatting.

function:src/data/BuffData.ts:formatPerk.name: formatPerkDescription
function:src/data/BuffData.ts:formatPerk.summary: Replaces 'x%' placeholders in a perk description with the computed potency percentage from calcPotencyPercent.

file::src/lib/types.ts.name: types.ts
file::src/lib/types.ts.summary: Core type definitions module for the voxlblade-builder project. Defines fundamental stat types (StatKey, StatMap), equipment interfaces (Race, Guild, Armor, Ring, Rune), weapon component types (WeaponBlade, WeaponHandle, MonkGlove, MonkEssence), the full BuildState interface, proc coefficient handling (ProcCoefficient, ProcScalingType), boost system types (BoostEntry, BoostResult), and upgrade logic. Also re-exports DMG_TYPE_COLORS and DMG_TYPE_PRIORITY from constants. This file is the foundational type layer imported by nearly every other module in the engine and data layers.

function:src/lib/types.ts:applyUpgrade.name: applyUpgrade
function:src/lib/types.ts:applyUpgrade.summary: Applies an upgrade level multiplier to a StatMap. Positive stat values are scaled up by (1 + level * 0.1) and negative values are scaled down (divided), producing an upgraded copy of the stats. Returns a shallow copy with no mutation.

function:src/lib/types.ts:getProcCoeffVa.name: getProcCoeffValue
function:src/lib/types.ts:getProcCoeffVa.summary: Extracts the numeric proc coefficient value from a ProcCoefficient union type. Returns 0 for 'noProc', the stored value for 'hasCoeff', and a default of 1 when undefined.

function:src/lib/types.ts:canProc.name: canProc
function:src/lib/types.ts:canProc.summary: Determines whether a given ProcCoefficient allows procing by checking if its resolved value is greater than 0. Delegates to getProcCoeffValue.

file::src/lib/store.ts.name: store.ts
file::src/lib/store.ts.summary: Svelte store module managing build state persistence, enchantment manipulation, guild/race configuration, and armor/ring slot reordering. Exports reactive stores and updater functions that form the central state management layer for the Voxel Blade damage calculator.

function:src/lib/store.ts:loadBuild.name: loadBuild
function:src/lib/store.ts:loadBuild.summary: Loads the persisted BuildState from localStorage, merges it with defaults via spread operator, and returns a complete BuildState. Uses defensive try/catch to fall back to defaults on parse errors or missing data.

function:src/lib/store.ts:setEnchantment.name: setEnchantment
function:src/lib/store.ts:setEnchantment.summary: Sets a single enchantment value at a given index within a specified armor slot. Delegates constraint enforcement (e.g. no duplicate enchantments) to the engine's enforceEnchantSlot function.

function:src/lib/store.ts:swapEnchantmen.name: swapEnchantments
function:src/lib/store.ts:swapEnchantmen.summary: Swaps the entire enchantment arrays between two different armor slots. Short-circuits if both slots are the same.

function:src/lib/store.ts:clearBuild.name: clearBuild
function:src/lib/store.ts:clearBuild.summary: Resets the entire build state to the DEFAULT_BUILD constant, effectively restoring all equipment, enchantments, and settings to initial values.

function:src/lib/store.ts:setGuild.name: setGuild
function:src/lib/store.ts:setGuild.summary: Sets the guild name and rank. Automatically forces the race to 'DRAGON BLOODED' and initializes draconic color if the guild is 'Draconic'; clears draconic fields otherwise.

function:src/lib/store.ts:moveArmorSlot.name: moveArmorSlot
function:src/lib/store.ts:moveArmorSlot.summary: Moves or clones an armor piece between a primary slot (helmet/chestplate/leggings) and its infusion counterpart. Validates slot compatibility via armorSupportsSlot, swaps or copies the upgrade level, and returns whether the move succeeded.

function:src/lib/store.ts:canArmorMoveTo.name: canArmorMoveToSlot
function:src/lib/store.ts:canArmorMoveTo.summary: Predicate that checks whether a given armor name is compatible with a target slot type (Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings) by delegating to armorSupportsSlot.

function:src/lib/store.ts:moveRingSlot.name: moveRingSlot
function:src/lib/store.ts:moveRingSlot.summary: Moves or clones a ring between the primary ring slot and its infusion counterpart, including the associated upgrade level. Follows the same clone-or-swap pattern as moveArmorSlot.

function:src/App.svelte:getGridDragActio.summary: Determines the drag action label (clone/move/swap) for a grid drag source and target.

function:src/App.svelte:gridHitTest.summary: Performs hit-testing to find which data-slot cell is under the pointer during grid drag.

function:src/App.svelte:handleGridTouchS.summary: Initiates custom touch-based grid drag with touch position capture.

function:src/App.svelte:onGridTouchMove.name: onGridTouchMove
function:src/App.svelte:onGridTouchMove.summary: Tracks touch movement during grid drag, creates ghost, performs hit testing, and updates badge.

function:src/App.svelte:onGridTouchEnd.name: onGridTouchEnd
function:src/App.svelte:onGridTouchEnd.summary: Completes grid touch drag: executes move/clone/swap and cleans up.

function:src/App.svelte:ensureActionBadg.name: ensureActionBadge
function:src/App.svelte:ensureActionBadg.summary: Lazily creates and returns the floating action badge DOM element for drag feedback.

function:src/App.svelte:toggleUpgrade.name: toggleUpgrade

function:src/App.svelte:substringLevensh.name: substringLevenshtein

function:src/App.svelte:filterWeaponItem.name: filterWeaponItems
function:src/App.svelte:filterWeaponItem.summary: Filters weapon parts (blades, handles, gloves, essences) by search query, stat filter, tags, and tier.

function:src/App.svelte:itemMatchesStatF.name: itemMatchesStatFilter

function:src/App.svelte:sortByStatFilter.name: sortByStatFilter
function:src/App.svelte:sortByStatFilter.summary: Sorts items by stat filter mode (highest, lowest, alphabetical, most-effective, brawny).

function:src/App.svelte:getDamageTypes.name: getDamageTypes

function:src/App.svelte:formatCD.name: formatCD

function:src/App.svelte:buildSlotCard.name: buildSlotCard

function:src/App.svelte:buildInfusionCar.name: buildInfusionCard
function:src/App.svelte:buildInfusionCar.summary: Constructs a DetailCard for infusion slot stat/perk display.

function:src/App.svelte:onKeydown.name: onKeydown

function:src/App.svelte:splitWeaponStats.name: splitWeaponStats
function:src/App.svelte:splitWeaponStats.summary: Separates a weapon's stat map into damage types, scalings, and boosts for display grouping.

function:src/BuildSaves.svelte:loadSlots.name: loadSlots
